events.address: Madison Square Park, southeast corner near Fifth Avenue, Broadway and 23rd Street, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: A free US Open fan experience with AI-powered tennis activations, live match viewing, an AI photo booth, serve-speed testing and ping-pong experiences.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the fan experience and its interactive activations is free. Official US Open merchandise is available separately for purchase.
events.caveats: IBM's official release says the activations are open to the public. The Sunday schedule runs through 7 PM. Merchandise is not included with admission.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 11 AM–7 PM. The men's singles final coverage begins at 2 PM. The activation is at the southeast corner of Madison Square Park near IBM's One Madison Avenue office.

events.what_it_is: A brownstone-inspired NYFW pop-up with hair and beauty refresh stations, an experiential photo booth, on-site legwear customization and complimentary coffee.
events.what_is_free: Entry is open to the public. Current listings advertise complimentary coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle/beauty touch-ups and the photo booth. Hand embroidery is complimentary only with purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: The pop-up is described as open to the public by multiple current listings. The tights vending-machine products are paid, and embroidery is not a no-purchase freebie: it is complimentary with purchase of the eligible knee highs. Promotional inventory and partner sampling may be limited.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or host approval requirement is stated in the current listings.

occurrences.details: Free public fan experience; men's final coverage begins at 2 PM.
Open to the public; coffee, stickers, touch-ups and photo booth are free, while embroidery requires purchase of eligible knee highs.
